5 Days Ol Pejeta Lake Nakuru Maasai Mara Safari

Package overview

Embark on an unforgettable 5-day wildlife adventure through three of Kenya’s most iconic safari destinations. From the rare rhinos of Ol Pejeta Conservancy , the flamingo-fringed shores of Lake Nakuru National Park

  • Ol Pejeta
  • The Last Northern White Rhinos: The most poignant highlight is visiting Najin and Fatu, the last two remaining northern white rhinos in the world, a truly once-in-a-lifetime encounter that underscores the importance of global conservation efforts.
  • Rhino Sanctuary: Ol Pejeta is East Africa's largest black rhino sanctuary, with a robust and growing population of over 100 individuals, offering excellent opportunities to see these endangered animals in their natural habitat
  • The "Big Five": The conservancy is home to all members of the Big Five: elephant, lion, leopard, buffalo, and rhino. Its high wildlife-to-land ratio makes sightings of these iconic species fairly common.
  • Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary : This is the only place in Kenya where you can see chimpanzees. The sanctuary provides a lifelong refuge for chimps rescued from various traumatic situations across Africa, in an agreement with the Jane Goodall Institute.
  • Lake Nakuru National Park
  • Rhino Sanctuary: Lake Nakuru National Park is Kenya's first government-protected rhino sanctuary and a major highlight. It hosts one of the largest concentrations of the critically endangered Eastern black rhino and a thriving population of Southern white rhino
  • Rare Rothschild's Giraffe: The park is a sanctuary for the endangered Rothschild's giraffe, which was translocated here for its protection.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi – Ol Pejeta Conservancy

Your safari begins with a scenic drive north to Ol Pejeta Conservancy , a pioneering wildlife reserve known for its conservation efforts. Arrive in time for lunch followed by an afternoon game drive. Explore the vast plains with chances to see rhinos, lions, elephants, giraffes, and the rare African wild dogs. Highlights: Visit the Chimpanzee Sanctuary Spot both black and white rhinos Big Five viewing Dinner and Overnight: Ol Pejeta / Sweetwaters Tented Camp or similar

02Day 2 | Ol Pejeta – Lake Nakuru

After breakfast, depart for the Great Rift Valley, descending into the dramatic landscape surrounding Lake Nakuru National Park . Enjoy lunch on arrival and head out for an afternoon game drive. This park is famous for its endangered rhinos , vibrant birdlife, and scenic viewpoints overlooking the lake. Highlights: Black and White Rhino Sanctuary Rothschild’s Giraffes Flamingoes and diverse bird species Dinner and Overnight: Lake Nakuru Lodge / Sarova Lion Hill Lodge or similar

03Day 3 | Lake Nakuru – Masai Mara National Reserve

Depart after breakfast and drive to the world-renowned Masai Mara , Kenya’s most celebrated wildlife reserve. Arrive in time for lunch followed by an afternoon game drive. Explore the endless plains dotted with wildlife—lions, cheetahs, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, and more. Highlights: Big Cat sightings Scenic savannah landscapes Sunset game drive Dinner and Overnight: Masai Mara Safari Lodge / Sentrim Mara / AA Mara Lodge or similar

04Day 4 | Full-Day Game Drive in Masai Mara

Spend the day exploring the Mara on an extensive game drive. You may also visit the Mara River , famous for the annual Great Migration (July–October). Picnic lunch will be served inside the park to maximize your wildlife viewing opportunities. Highlights: Full-day wildlife adventure Big Five sightings Optional Maasai village visit (extra cost) Dinner and Overnight: Masai Mara Safari Lodge or similar

05Day 5 | Masai Mara – Nairobi

Enjoy a relaxed breakfast before driving back to Nairobi. Upon arrival, you will be dropped off at your hotel or airport, marking the end of a memorable safari experience with Magical Africa Safaris . End of Safari Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.
